name: KAISER 235 GC

specs.notes: BMW's M235i xDrive Gran Coupe (F44): a 2.0 turbo four at 306 PS (225 kW) at 5,000-6,250 rpm and 450 N m at 1,750-4,500 rpm (ADAC's and Autotijd's data), xDrive, an eight-speed automatic, ~1,570 kg, 0-100 km/h in 4.9 s, 250 km/h limited. Its torque curve follows those (before October 2026 it held 450 N m to 5,500 rpm: 353 PS). Its aero is an estimate. Its gearbox is BMW's (media information, 10/2019: 5.519 / 3.184 / 2.050 / 1.492 / 1.235 / 1.000 / 0.801 / 0.673 on a 3.075 final drive), with its 250 km/h limiter; before October 2026 a 5.17 final drive ran it into the rev limiter in eighth at 250 km/h.

garage.blurb: A compact four-door with a strong turbo four and all-wheel drive: an easy, quick first car for the city.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/m235i_gc.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
